inputs.caption:
Global Metadata
Basic Attributes: bpm is 96. key is G, and scale is major. Indie Folk / Acoustic Pop.
Global Emotional Progression: Opens bright and curious, with a light forward pulse, and settles into a contented warmth by the end.
Application Scenarios & Imagery: An early walk along a grey shoreline as the tide goes out; gulls, wet sand, a thermos of coffee.
Sonics & Production Profile: A close, natural acoustic recording with a warm low-mid range, soft highs and gentle dynamics; little compression.
Vocal Details
Vocal Gender & Timbre: Singer A (Female). A warm, slightly breathy alto with a soft, close-miked intimacy.
Vocal Style: Gentle and conversational, rising to a fuller, open tone on the chorus lines.
Harmony/Backing Vocals: A single soft harmony on the last chorus only.
Vocal FX: A short, warm room reverb; no audible pitch correction.
Arrangement
Instrument Lifecycle Description (Primary/Secondary Layering):
Primary: A fingerpicked steel-string acoustic guitar carries the harmony from the first bar to the last.
Secondary: A soft upright piano adds single notes in the chorus and holds a final chord at the end.
Groove & Foundation Progression: No drum kit. A light brushed snare and a soft kick enter at the chorus to lift the pulse, then drop away for the last line.
Embellishments, Textures & Spatial FX: Faint room ambience; a gentle guitar slide into the chorus.
inputs.lyrics:
[Verse]
Salt on the window, the kettle's awake
Footprints are filling as fast as I make

[Chorus]
Low tide, low tide, show me what you keep
Shells and the shapes of the things I don't need
